name: standing
description: Anny's rest pose (A-pose, arms about 40 degrees from the body). Standing measurements are taken here.
provenance: Fit-engine-poc 2.2, 2026-10-14. No rotations: the rest pose itself.
convention: Anny local-ref pose parameterization. Each rotation is [rx, ry, rz] in degrees about axes aligned with the world in the rest pose, applied as Rz*Ry*Rx relative to the parent bone. World axes: +X body's left, -Y forward, +Z up. Positive rx tips a bone forward. Rotating root tilts the whole body about the pelvis.
